varieties.name: Atlantic
varieties.best_suited_for: Flakes for frying batters and snacks; high solids, low reducing sugars, light colour

varieties.name: Shepody
varieties.best_suited_for: Premium flakes for instant mash; long tuber shape, uniform dry matter

varieties.name: Russet Burbank
varieties.best_suited_for: Bakery-grade flakes and dough incorporation; high starch, mealy texture

varieties.name: Innovator
varieties.best_suited_for: Dual-purpose mash and frying; excellent colour stability

notes: Company names (for example McCain Foods) are processors, not varieties. Ranges are typical for the variety under the stated agronomy; lot values vary with season.
